perpend.definition:
v. t. To weight carefully in the mind.
v. i. To attend; to be attentive.
perpend.translation: v. 慎重考虑, 深思

perpender.definition:
n. A large stone reaching through a wall so as to appear on
   both sides of it, and acting as a binder; -- called also perbend,
   perpend stone, and perpent stone.
perpender.translation: n. 【建筑学】贯石(贯穿墙壁而露其两端的长石);穿墙石;控石 [亦作 perpent ／'pə:pent／ , parpen,亦称作 through stone]

perpendicular.definition:
n. a straight line at right angles to another line
n. a Gothic style in 14th and 15th century England; characterized by vertical lines and a four-centered (Tudor) arch and fan vaulting
n. an extremely steep face
perpendicular.translation:
n. 垂直线, 垂直的位置, 直立(姿势), 刚正, 垂规
a. 垂直的, 直立的, 陡峭的

perpendicular fasciculi.translation: [医] 垂直束(大脑颞、枕、顶叶的垂直联合纤维)

perpendicular style.translation: [网络] 垂直式风格；垂直式建筑设计；垂针

perpendicularity.definition: n. the quality of being at right angles to a given line or plane (especially the plane of the horizon)
perpendicularity.translation:
n. 垂直, 直立
[机] 垂直

perpendicularly.translation: adv. 垂直地, 直立地

perpendiculars.translation: 垂直的, 成直角的( perpendicular的名词复数 )；直立的
